data.title: 矢来美羽 · 唱针落下之前
data.description: 窗边的矮柜上刚摆好旧唱机。美羽俯身捏住唱片两侧，等孔眼对准短轴才松手。唱片还没开始转，百叶窗的亮纹已经横过哑光的黑色唱盘。
data.action: 捏住唱片边缘，把唱片垂直放到唱机轴上
data.camera: 前侧方中景，唱机与两手同框
data.promptProse: Miu bends over a turntable in her pale green lounge clothes, holding an old vinyl record by its edges with both hands. She aligns its center hole over the spindle before lowering it. Narrow stripes of afternoon sun catch the record and the sleeves of her top.
data.animaCaption: Both hands hold the record by its rim as the center hole reaches the spindle.
